question: Do the same ten native Cano train meshes satisfy noise-bounded replay when vertices are compared to opposite triangle surfaces rather than non-corresponding Poisson vertices?
method: Repeat M0R2 from scratch on the unchanged ten fixed train sentinels and seeds. Preserve exact graph, spline, operation trace, effective geometry parameters, axis and vertex count; triangle-count relative difference <=0.01%; individual mesh, AABB and area checks. Replace only nearest-vertex maximum pass/fail with bidirectional vertex-to-opposite-triangle-surface maximum <=0.75 m, while retaining nearest-vertex statistics as diagnostics.
baseline: Sealed M0R2 passed S01-S07 and stopped at S08 because three of 185205 replay vertices had nearest-primary-vertex distance above 0.75 m. Read-only S08 point-to-opposite-surface maxima were 0.494647/0.502614 m and all other checks passed.

user_authorization.scope: One M0R3 implementation and execution with unchanged ten train sentinels, twenty native meshes, ten previews and zero validation/test inspection, LiDAR or training; only the replay distance object changes to opposite triangle surface with unchanged 0.75 m.
user_authorization.confirmation_reference: User replied 继续 after receiving the sealed M0R2 review and exact M0R3 proposal.

acceptance_criteria: Approved M0R3 proposal/card, frozen tools, E1/Cano identity, 146/146 M0R2, 17/17 V2R and 391/391 V2 evidence match before RUNNING.
Same ten train sentinels reconstruct with exact graph, spline, operation trace, effective parameters, axis and vertex count; zero validation/development-test read.
Exactly twenty new native meshes and ten complete train maps are produced without retry, replacement, repair or failed-run reuse.
All meshes pass individual quality; all pairs pass triangle-count relative difference <=0.01%, bidirectional point-to-surface maximum <=0.75 m, AABB <=0.5 m and area difference <=1%.
Output remains <=3600 seconds and <=1.5 GiB; LiDAR, labels, formal data, training, models, trajectories, simulators and M-TARE changes stay zero.
stop_conditions: Any approval, source seal, frozen identity, import, disk, run-state or scope mismatch
Any exact input/axis/vertex, mesh quality, triangle discretization or point-to-surface criterion fails
Any adaptation, new seed, replacement, retry, repair, failed-run reuse or validation/development-test inspection would be required
Executor exceeds 3600 seconds or output exceeds 1.5 GiB
expected_evidence: Frozen M0R2/V2R/V2/tool/environment identities, command, log, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal
Twenty materializations and ten metrics with exact input/axis/vertex and mesh audits
Bidirectional point-to-surface and diagnostic nearest-vertex distributions plus count/AABB/area/hash records
Ten complete train maps and explicit zero data/training/simulator/M-TARE counts

estimated_cost.compute: Frozen E1 CPU; twenty native Cano meshes plus point-to-triangle-surface queries; no LiDAR, simulator or training.
